# enumwaii

> TypeScript string enums with declaration ownership, runtime parsing, Standard Schema support, composition, exhaustive derivation, and optional lint enforcement.

Enumwaii is for finite, authored vocabularies whose values drive application behavior. Members remain ordinary strings at runtime while a required TypeScript brand prevents raw strings or members from unrelated declarations from entering trusted application code accidentally.

Start with the full agent guide for the ownership model and safe workflow. Follow the focused Markdown guides when a task involves a particular API surface, integration, or TypeScript limitation.

## Start here

- [Full agent guide](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/llms.md): Product model, API boundaries, limitations, and an implementation workflow.
- [Getting started](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/getting-started.md): Installation, declaration, extraction, parsing, and first lint setup.
- [Core API](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/core-api.md): Parsing options, composition, derivation, and declaration-local types.

## Ownership and boundaries

- [Branding and identity](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/branding-and-identity.md): Why enumwaii requires a brand and how identity behaves through composition.
- [Member surfaces](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/member-surfaces.md): When to use `.enum`, `.values`, `.rawEnum`, `.rawValues`, and the narrow `.cases` escape hatch.
- [Runtime boundaries](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/runtime-boundaries.md): Parsing external JSON, routes, forms, databases, providers, and agent output.
- [API decisions and limitations](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs.md): Design tradeoffs and TypeScript restrictions that shape the public API.

## Tooling and integrations

- [Schemas and adapters](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/adapters.md): Standard Schema support plus optional Zod and Valibot adapters.
- [Derivation](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/derivation.md): Exhaustive member-indexed data and source-to-target mappings.
- [ESLint plugin](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/eslint-plugin.md): Syntax-only and type-aware rules with flagged and accepted examples.
- [AI agents](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/agents.md): Packaged skill, setup prompt, and read-only migration analysis prompt.

## Optional

- [Generated API reference](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/api/enumwaii/): Detailed signatures generated from the public JSDoc surface.
- [Runnable examples](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/examples.md): Framework, runtime, database, form, table, and mobile applications.
- [Documentation architecture](https://catofjupit3r.github.io/enumwaii/docs/documentation-system.md): How the Fumadocs site, generated API reference, Twoslash examples, Markdown routes, export checks, and GitHub Pages deployment fit together.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/CatOfJupit3r/enumwaii): Packages, tests, examples, documentation source, and contribution guidance.
